Subject: Deploy orchestration runbook alignment + architecture deep-dive

Hi Alexis / Sam —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we get closer to pilot, we'd like to run a focused architecture deep-dive and align on the deploy orchestration runbook (handoff, failure modes, and cross-region routing). Goal: 60–75 min session with an ops playbook review and Q&A.

Proposed windows (pick one that works for your team):
- Tue Oct 13 — 2:00–3:15pm BST / 9:00–10:15am EDT (US-friendly)
- Wed Oct 14 — 9:00–10:15am SGT / 6:00–7:15pm BST (APAC/EMEA overlap)
- Thu Oct 15 — 8:00–9:15am PDT / 4:00–5:15pm BST (handy for our EU engineers)

Attached: initial runbook draft (redwood_deploy_runbook_v1.pdf) and a short agenda (meeting_agenda.docx). If there are specific compliance items or network diagrams you want covered, add them to the Drive doc linked below before Wed.

Ask: please confirm participants from your side (eng, security, procurement) so we can include the right playbook sections.

Thanks — I can spin up a calendar invite once we lock a time.

—Priyom

Priyom — thanks. Executive leadership has a conflict Tue afternoon and Sam will be traveling Wed morning. Quick ask: can we move to Thu (the 15th) or early next week? Thu 4:00pm BST / 11:00am EDT would work for Alexis + security lead (we can loop procurement after the tech session).

Also: rather than the full runbook, would you include a short, two-slide overview of the cross-region failover plan and the KV cache behavior under network partition? Our security engineer will want that up-front.

If you can share a simple high-level diagram (PNG) I can confirm the rest of the attendees.

Best,

Thanks — Thu the 15th is fine. I created a provisional invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-cloudfin-arch (please accept when you can). New time: Thu Oct 15 — 16:00 BST / 11:00 EDT / 08:00 PDT.

Per request I've attached a trimmed architecture diagram (arch_high_level_diagram.png) and I'll lead with a 5–7 minute failover + KV cache primer before we walk the runbook. Marcus will cover routing fallback policies and Karthik will go over autoscaling behavior and caching knobs.

Action items before Thu:
- Alexis: confirm security lead + procurement contact (if procurement needs to attend)
- CloudFin: flag any specific compliance artifacts you want referenced in the runbook
- Everyone: edit the Drive runbook draft if you have redlines: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cRunbookDraft

Attachments:
- arch_high_level_diagram.png (high-level cross-region flow)
- redwood_deploy_runbook_v1.pdf (linked in Drive as well)

Thanks — I'll include a short recording consent note in the invite.
